integrity: All algebraic claims were reconstructed from the displayed system, Jacobian, coefficient definitions, and first integral. Exact-rational witness checks and first-integral derivative checks are supplied in verify.py. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: The result corrects the interior-equilibrium stability classification of the printed continuous-time replicator system. It does not challenge the static payoff matrix, welfare accounting, unique-pure-equilibrium cases, or alternative adaptive dynamics. The generic center case \(A_AA_B<0\) is not realized by an interior equilibrium under the tariff coefficient definitions.
title: A determinant sign reversal eliminates the tariff model’s claimed center regime
